lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Crate\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

The app reads and writes its app config in 1 place and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
lib/Controller/SettingsController.php:226 getAppValue()
Nothing in the app calls 2 OCS routes. OCS is there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
PUT /ocs/v2.php/apps/crate/api/v1/settings/currency  ocs.crate.settings.setcurrency  appinfo/routes.php:5 ocs
GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/crate/api/v1/home  ocs.crate.home.home  appinfo/routes.php:5 ocs
The app has 61 OCS routes and no openapi.json. Clients of OCS are generated from such a specification, and nothing else tells them what these routes take and return.
